snippet.title: ECOVACS DEEBOT T80 OMNI vs. Dreame L40s Ultra Showdown
snippet.description:
ECOVACS DEEBOT T80 OMNI: https://tinyurl.com/5ayrzuzk (LIMITED TIME PRIME DAY DISCOUNT $399 Regularly $549.99 from 6/14/26 to 6/26/26)

Both robots are very similar in vacuum performance when tested against my standard paper shred and pet hair test. The mop coverage is also similar but the stand out difference between the two is that the T80 has a self cleaning mop that can clean up large sticky messes. The Dreame L40s is able to clean the same ketchup stain but require 7 passes to have a similar clean as the Ecovacs T80. The T80 uses the Ozmo roller that continuously cleans itself so it doesn't smear the ketchup all over the kitchen floor while cleaning. The Dreame would not wash the mop immediately so it ended up smearing the ketchup across the entire floor. This is not a complete deal breaker though because you really have to think about how often you would tell the robot to clean up a large sauce mess? It's possible to make it work by spot cleaning any potential large messes.

Therefore, if you know what the robot is capable of, you can optimize what you throw at it so that it can complement you cleaning routine. For the T80, the OZMO roller mop is the clear differentiator.
